prompt_text: Who is the best interior painting company in St. Louis MO?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” interior painter in St. Louis — the right company depends on your needs (size of project, budget, timeline, quality level, whether you want color consultation or low‑VOC paints, etc.). I can help you find the best match. A quick plan and some questions will narrow it down:

Quick questions so I can recommend companies:
- What is your zip code or neighborhood?
- Is this residential or commercial?
- How many rooms / approximate square feet?
- Desired start date / timeline?
- Any special preferences (low‑VOC paint, color consultation, wallpaper removal, high ceilings, trim/cabinet painting)?

How to pick the best interior painter (criteria to use)
- Local reviews: Google, Yelp, Angi, Houzz; check recent photos of completed jobs.
- Licensing & insurance: they should be insured and offer guarantees/warranty.
- Written estimate: itemized — prep, number of coats, paint brand, labor, cleanup.
- References: ask for recent references or project photos similar to yours.
- Prep & workmanship: look for emphasis on surface prep (patching, sanding, priming).
- Communication: clear timeline, project manager, final walkthrough.

Questions to ask when you get a quote
1. Are you licensed/insured? Can you provide proof?  
2. Will I get a written, itemized estimate? What’s included/excluded?  
3. What paint brands and product lines do you use? Are low‑VOC options available?  
4. How many coats and will you prime?  
5. Who will do the work (employees or subcontractors)?  
6. What is your cleanup process and timeline?  
7. Do you provide a warranty or touch‑up guarantee? For how long?  
8. Can you show photos of similar finished work and a couple of references?  
9. Project timeline: start date and completion estimate?  
10. Payment schedule and accepted methods?

Typical cost ranges (ballpark)
- Per square foot (walls): roughly $1.50–$4.00/ft² (labor + paint) depending on prep and paint quality.  
- Per room: often $300–$1,200 per room (small bedroom near low end; large room/high ceilings or heavy prep near high end).  
These vary by complexity and company.

If you want, I can:
- Pull together a short list (3–5) of highly rated interior painters in St. Louis near your zip code.
- Draft an email or phone script to request quotes.
Tell me your zip code and a few project details and I’ll find specific, well‑reviewed options and prepare comparison notes.
